notes.title: Official Ball 3D Rankings on discord
notes.content:
Now everyone can join our official Ball 3D discord and play ranking games. It is super easy.

- Just join: https://ball3d.com/discord

- Go to the #5v5-faq channel to read about how to play.

In ranking games you earn points that reflect your skill. It is a great way to check how good you are and compete with other great players.

The atmosphere on our discord is super friendly. We invite you to join and play with other players.

notes.title: Last Updates
notes.content:
In the last 3 updates, we had a few changes:
- Switch Kick is now a bit more difficult to use. In simple words it can be explained as follows: you can use it 2 times but before using it the 3rd time, you need to wait a little bit.
- Basketball was changed, now it is harder to score from far away and players move slower.
- Hockey was completely changed. The puck doesn't stick to the players anymore, goals are bigger, there can be only one GK in the goal area, kicks are stronger, sprint was limited.
- Weather effects now work in Hockey and Basketball.
- Beginners can now use their rooms for 90 days but they can join to expert rooms after 14 days (same as it was before).

notes.title: Ball 3D Community Events
notes.content:
Ball 3D community is growing! A lot is going on in the game but also on the official discord server.

1. We announced 2020 Best Goal Award. You can send your most beautiful goal to participate in the competition. Maybe your goal will be picked as the Goal Of They Year and you will win the prize?

2. Another competition we currently have is to use the Ball Editor to create the best looking balls. Here 10 players will win 5 keys each.

3. On the Official Discord we talk in English, but yesterday we opened national channels for Poland, Turkey and Argentina (more will come), where you can talk in your native language.

4. New tournaments will be announced in the near future. Make sure to join our discord to be part of them.

5. On the discord you can talk with me (the developer) and with the admins of the game. You can post your ideas, find a team you can play in and much more. We are waiting there for you.

[b]Ball 3D Discord: [url=http://ball3d.com/discord]http://ball3d.com/discord[/url][/b]

Go to the #news channel on discord to read the details.

notes.title: Fast Rooms Update
notes.content:
New rooms with the speed of the players increased from 3.0 to 4.0 have been added to Ball 3D!

This is how I intended this game to work from the beginning, but for various reasons I was forced to decrease the speed just before realising the game 8 years ago. Now you will experience the real Ball 3D as I imagined it.

This new mode is available on the FAST rooms, test it and let me know what you think, I will improve these new rooms in the upcoming weeks.

The old slow rooms are still available as the main mode of the game for old players and they will stay in the game, so don't worry about this.
